earnings.title: Moderna Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Updates
highlights: Reports third quarter revenue of $1.3 billion, GAAP net income of $0.2 billion and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.38

Revenue : Total revenue for the third quarter of 2026 increased 29% to $1.3 billion, compared to $1.0 billion in the same period in 2025, primarily driven by higher COVID vaccine sales in international markets, supported by deliveries under long-term strategic government partnerships.
Revenue was $780 million in the U.S. and $533 million in international markets.
Increases 2026 expected revenue growth to 15%–25%, exceeding the previous expectation of up to 10% growth
Cost of Sales: Cost of sales for the third quarter of 2026 was $318 million, including $65 million of third-party royalties.

quotes.text: We delivered 29% revenue growth in the third quarter, alongside the U.S. approval of mFLUSIVA, our fifth approved product globally, and positive Phase 3 results for intismeran in melanoma.
quotes.by: Stéphane Bancel, Chief Executive Officer of Moderna

outlook: Improves 2026 GAAP operating expense outlook by approximately $0.2 billion from previous estimate
Revenue: The Company now expects total revenue growth of 15% to 25% in 2026, exceeding its previous outlook of up to 10% growth.
Cost of Sales: Cost of sales for 2026 is expected to be approximately $1.7 billion, including the previously announced $0.9 billion non-recurring litigation settlement charge.

Research and Development Expenses: Research and development expenses for 2026 are expected to be approximately $2.7 billion, reduced from the Company's previous expectation of approximately $2.9 billion.
